description:
Yun Nuonuo (云糯糯): 6 years old, Sect Master of Tianyun Sword Sect in Ancient China, flying across the world on her superpowerful sword.

NOW, Yun Nuonuo comes to Web3 as NUONUO, an ATC-20 memecoin dedicated to running on AtlantisChain — the world’s ONLY ultra-fast Layer-0 blockchain with 3,600,000 TPS and 0.031-second block time.

NUONUO offers holders, traders, and users instant finality, fixed ultra-low gas fees, and AI contract capabilities, making it a high-velocity digital asset worldwide.
name: Yun Nuonuo the Sword Sect Master
